dct_title_s: Philippines Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Jul 2022
dct_description_sm: # Philippines Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Jul 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Philippines Earthquake (Jul 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Philippines, Lindol, 7 Agosto 2022, v0.9** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Philippines, Lindol, 7 Agosto 2022, v0.9** **More map details and files:** **Kredito:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Naglalaman ng binagong Copernicus Sentinel data (2022)
